sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use 'soon' in the phrases 'See you soon' and 'Get well soon', as a signing-off device.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: see you / get well + soon — closes the conversation with a forward-pointing adverb
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker hands the hearer a near-future expectation as a parting signal

positives: See you soon.
Get well soon.
negatives: I will come back soon after lunch.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of adverbs ('here', 'there') to indicate place.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: here / there — point to a place on the conversational stage
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker deictically anchors an entity in shared space

positives: My girlfriend is here with me.
I was born there and I lived there over twenty years.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of adverbs and adverb phrases ('so much', 'a lot') with verbs to indicate degree or intensity.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: so much / a lot — amplify the verb to maximum volume
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker cranks the speaker-level of feeling or action

positives: I am looking forward to seeing you so much!
We listened to music and we danced a lot too.
negatives: He is so kind to me.
I love you more than anything.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use 'really' and 'very much' with verbs expressing preference ('like', 'love'), for emphasis.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: really / very much + like/love — turn the dial past the standard setting
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker marks the affective state as more than ordinary

positives: I really like theatre and classical music.
I really love my space!
negatives: I would like to go home.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of adverbs ('also', 'so', 'however') to show a relationship between two clauses or sentences.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: also / so / however — wire two ideas into one discourse
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker binds clauses into a relationship of addition, result, or contrast

positives: I also bought some t-shirts.
I don't like green, so I decided to use blue.
negatives: I went to the cinema yesterday.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use 'very' to make adjectives stronger.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: very + adjective — push the adjective past its default setting
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker escalates the force of a quality word

positives: He's a very good man.
I'm very happy in my home.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of adverbs ('always', 'sometimes') to talk about frequency.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: always / sometimes — place the event on a frequency dial
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker locates the event on the spectrum from never-to-always

positives: I like Dorchester's people, they are always very friendly and polite.
I always see Safora because she lives near my home.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of adverbs ('yesterday', 'just', 'now', 'already') to refer to the timing of an event.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: yesterday / just / now / already — pin the event to a point on the speech-time line
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker anchors the event relative to S

positives: Yesterday I went shopping.
I've just seen your mail.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of manner adverbs and adverb phrases to modify how something happens.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: well / straight / slowly — describe HOW the action is performed
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker sculpts the texture of the verb's action

positives: Both the players played well.
You must go straight, then turn left.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use an increasing range of adverbs ('usually', 'often', 'never', 'weekly') to talk about frequency.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: usually / often / never / weekly — finer-grained frequency markers
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker positions the event on a denser frequency scale

positives: People usually try to eat their breakfast between 7 and 9 am.
I have to pay weekly or monthly?

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of degree adverbs ('so', 'quite', 'too') to modify adjectives.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: so / quite / too + adjective — turn the adjective up or down
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker sets the adjective's intensity on a non-default position

positives: It's so beautiful.
It was quite expensive, it cost one hundred pounds.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of adverbs ('only', 'just') to focus on or point to something.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: only / just — spotlight a single element, dimming the rest
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker isolates one referent from a presumed larger set

positives: It's only two hours.
I have only one chance.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of adverbs and adverb phrases ('first', 'then', 'after that') to order segments of discourse.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: first / then / after that — map the events onto a timeline
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker arranges discourse events in chronological order

positives: First we had a dinner, then we went to a disco.
Add the eggs, then stir for two minutes.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use an increasing range of adverbs to refer to the timing of an event.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: recently / immediately / eventually / finally — finer time-pointers
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker pinpoints the event on a more granular S-anchored line

positives: I went to the cinema with a new friend recently.
I immediately called her to see if everything was OK.
negatives: I went to the cinema yesterday.

sub_category: adverbs and adverb phrases: types and meanings
can_do_statement: Can use an increasing range of manner adverbs and adverb phrases to modify how something happens.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: carefully / gradually / properly — wider texture palette for the verb's HOW
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker expands the texture vocabulary of the action

positives: The teacher spoke slowly to the class.
He drove carefully through the storm.
negatives: She sang at the party last night.
He drives his car to work.
